headline: Bangladesh Connects First Nuclear Power Plant Unit to National Grid
summary: Bangladesh successfully connected the initial unit of the Russian-built Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant to the national electricity grid for trial operations.
why: The Rooppur facility is Bangladesh's first nuclear energy project, intended to reduce reliance on imported fossil fuels.

impacts.name: Bangladesh
impacts.why: First nuclear power generation unit integrated into the national grid.
